p=bytearray()
p+=b'PK\x03\x04'
p+=(20).to_bytes(2,'little')
p+=(0).to_bytes(2,'little') # gpf

p+=(0).to_bytes(2,'little') # time
p+=(0).to_bytes(2,'little') # date
p+=(0).to_bytes(4,'little') # crc
p+=(0).to_bytes(4,'little') # csize
p+=(0).to_bytes(4,'little') # usize
p+=(1).to_bytes(2,'little') # namelen
p+=(47).to_bytes(2,'little') # extralen -> handled 47
p+=b'a'
Path('/workspace/poc2.bin').write_bytes(p)
print(len(p), p.hex())
PY
